consequence.statement: Upgrading from a pre-1.0.0 release to 1.0.0+ involves significant API and upgrade-procedure changes, so operators must follow the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure. Stored manifests must be migrated to v1 API versions, because v1beta1 serving and the conversion webhooks are dropped at v1.1.0.
consequence.remediation: Follow the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure before upgrading. After moving to v1.0+, migrate all stored NodePool, EC2NodeClass and NodeClaim manifests to v1 API versions before upgrading to v1.1.0.

assertion.statement: Karpenter 1.0.0 introduces v1 APIs, and upgrading to 1.0.0+ requires following the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure; stored v1beta1 manifests must also be migrated to v1 before v1.1.0 stops serving v1beta1.
